_comment: Generated by tests/playout/timing-walk.test.ts (CR audit tool 1.15). Shrink-only. Each failure the timing walk finds in the seeded playouts, grouped by the area that owns its rule (tests/cr-citations/cr-section-owners.json) and by chart line, with the CR rules it breaks, the date it was first recorded, why it fails, and the first playout step that shows it (replay with replayTo in tests/playout/harness.ts). `unwalked` lists the chart lines the graph cites that no playout entered. `jumps` lists the moves off the chart that the end of the run or an ability made (CR 6.1.3-6.1.5); a new kind of move fails until someone checks it and regenerates.

11.4_6_a entered from 11.4_6_d by choose.reason: Window of Opportunity's run-end choice is answered while the run is at run.ends (11.4_6_d). The choose_option resume in src/actions/apply.ts (the "ETR from jack-out offer" branch) sees endedTheRun and enters run.closePriorityWindows, so 6.9.6a-d run a second time after the run is complete. Not in the findings table; area 14.
